verdict.rationale: The pack has no evidence of SSO/SAML/OIDC integration with an organization's identity provider for gating internal apps, deployments, or agents. Managed OIDC (render-docs-30) issues workload tokens so services can authenticate outbound to Anthropic/OpenAI, which is not IdP-based access control. MCP OAuth (render-docs-26) and private networking (render-docs-10) are adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can secure internal apps, deployments, and agents using my organization's identity provider
